entries.statement: Receipt fields are bound to EU AI Act Article 12, 26 and 50 and DORA Article 17.
Receipt fields are bound to six US obligations (NIST RMF, Colorado, Texas, NYDFS, HIPAA, SEC 17a-4) and CIRCIA provisionally.
An attestation envelope (DSSE + in-toto) carries two tiers: voluntary observation and authoritative attestation.
For code, the authoritative tier re-derives the subject digest from the source host rather than trusting the caller.
tests: profile: SHA-256 of raw unified diff re-fetched from source host
